Create NEW 2D painted RPG animation artwork based on the exact sword in the supplied references. This is the existing project monster Dancing Sword, not extracted original animation. Preserve EXACT identity: ONE slender upright slightly undulating/curved silver-white blade with an icy pale-blue edge, narrow tapering pointed tip, dark blade spine, asymmetrical small ornate aged-bronze/gold crossguard, long slim dark green/brown wrapped grip, tiny dark teal/bronze pommel. The complete original sword is very SLENDER, width roughly one quarter of height including crossguard; do not turn it into a huge broad fantasy broadsword. Keep blade length, shape, guard silhouette, grip length and material ratios consistent in every pose. The original black rectangle/shadow is only source background and must NOT be copied.
No hands, limbs, humanoid carrier, eyes, face, skull, armor, wings, ribbons, extra blades, new gems, magic orb, particles, motion trails, aura, fire or detached pieces. No3Dsystem asset: paint complete independent2D sprite views of the same weapon.

Runtime requirement: this particular sword is GROUNDED, floatingFALSE. It does NOT hover, hop or levitate. The pommel at the bottom of its grip is its standing contact pivot. Alive idle/travel/attack rock and pivot in contact at that local ground point; no vertical bob or hover gap. No ground/shadow is drawn in the transparent art itself. Do not use translation of one still to fake motion. Show real distinct pitch/yaw, blade flex and hilt rotation, preserving a solid connected weapon. Draw each camera view independently, not by mirroring. Materials remain identical.

Output actual clean RGBA cutouts. All non-sword background pixels alphaZERO; no low-alpha colored glow or spray, no painted checkerboard, no border/grid, no letters/numbers, no labels, no pedestal/floor/ground/shadow. Each isolated figure must have huge transparent margins and at least60px separation from neighbors. Slender swords can fit small: full sprite no more than40-45%cell width/height, long horizontal attacks/deaths still entirely inside their own cell. Never clip a tip or pommel. Keep same anatomy/material scale throughout the sheet.

Row4 TRAVEL_B: transition through nearly upright, distinctly different blade pitch/guard orientation and straightened flex, pommel contact maintained.

All20 are new physically different rigid-body/pitch/flex drawings, not translated stills or texture variants.

1 E: own heading SCREENRIGHT. Side of blade/guard is a genuine rightward yaw, intrinsic curved cutting edge aims right, forward strike extends RIGHT.

3 S: own heading toward viewer/downscreen. Front beveled blade and front bronze guard detail visible, frontward strike is foreshortened toward viewer.
4 SW: own heading diagonally down-left toward viewer, front-left three-quarter.
